scope: Individual event reconstruction and read-only retained-state observations; matched cohort conclusions remain pending.

definitions.stateTiming: Completed-cycle full states; their lattice fields come from the preceding relaxation, not a new solve on the post-update geometry.
definitions.boundaryTiming: Converged boundary observations before surface advance; sigmaBoundary is distinct from checkpoint lattice supersaturation.
definitions.fill: Preserved per-cell fill fractions, not flux or a claim that an unfilled cell can never attach. Attached-cell lattice sigma is omitted.
definitions.centralRegion: Registered first axial layers outside the seed and integer hex patches; coarse/fine site counts and seed geometry differ.
definitions.causality: Different preparations retain coupled geometry/fill/vapor/history differences; no component was transplanted or isolated.

matchedCohortComparisons.reason: Run the registered A/B/C cohort comparisons only with complete, bound operands and explicit missing coverage.

rows.reason: no complete terminal result and exit

retainedObservations.missingMeaning: Unavailable at this observation; a pending row may not have reached the trigger, while an earlier terminal row may never reach it.
